company_info.company_description: "RESINC Solar is one of Australia’s most wwarded and highest rated solar companies - trusted by thousands of homeowners, businesses, and community organisations since 2016.We specialise in residential and commercial solar and battery systems, backed by unmatched after-install support and a fully staffed proactive customer service team. We’re accredited as a Gold Master Electrician - the highest level of recognition in the industry - and hold rare triple ISO certification (ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001) for quality, safety, and environmental management.RESINC is a top-rate rated solar company on SolarQuotes (Legendary Status), Australia’s most popular solar company via the SunWiz Industry Awards, and the 2025 Smart Energy Council Installer of the Year. We’ve also topped review platforms like Trustpilot and ProductReview, with thousands of five-star reviews from real customers.Our customers care about results: real savings, zero-stress service, and a team that’s still there long after the install. As a social enterprise, we also give back with every install - supporting surf clubs, veterans, schools, animal rescue groups, and community organisations across Australia.If you want the best outcome, the most reliable service, and long-term value from your solar investment - we’d love to help."

reviews.review_description: Resinc have delivered what they've told us at the beginning. It's a quality product and overall it's been an easy experience. The solar panels also looks great on the roof
We have had the system for 4 years & no issues. The system pays for itself and we have had months without getting a bill! We love how much it saves us.

Honestly, the product speaks for itself; it’s almost hard to believe how amazing everything is. Not to mention, the app that comes with it is really intuitive and shows so much information.
The customer service has been great, I also just bought a battery from Resinc, I'm looking forward to getting that installed and watching my savings grow even more.
Resinc have great service, an easy installation process, great communication and everything went so smoothly. We are very happy after going solar with Resinc!
We’re happy with our solar and glad these guys come out every year to help us with our bills and find better plans that help us maximise our solar, even after two and a half years.

Dealing with multiple people from RESINC is understandable, but they should read the correspondents before calling and asking the same questions.

A professional installation. I think Resinc are a solid company, they have some good environmental principals operating. A very professional job and the follow up service after it was installed was great.

I really like the fact that these guys are local, it reassures us that they’re not just another company that’s going to install the system and then disappear. Their after-sales support has also been incredible, and my bill repayments have gone down quite substantially, which I’m really happy with.

An easy experience, very professional. Good service to start with and continuing service.

It was great, mostly easy to use. Upfront costs seemed a little scary but very happy to pay more for the quality and long warranty.

My motivation for installing solar was due to my high energy bills. I did my research on Resinc and liked what I found. The team has been great to speak with and very friendly to deal with. Not to mention, the monitoring app that comes with it is easy to use.

They went above and beyond to help us when needed. If there were any issues they would've fixed it. Couldn't have been in any better hands. Everything’s actually been great over the last year and a half. They keep calling me regularly to check in, just as they promised during the initial sales stage and they’ve really kept that promise.

The past year has been perfect. I’ve found the follow-up service to be fantastic. I have family members who had solar installed by different companies, and they haven’t heard from them at all. My bills have also been greatly reduced, which is so good to see.

The communication and efficiency in response time is what sets Resinc apart. We even had a follow up call with them and my husband mentioned that we were interested in a battery, they got in touch really quickly to help us out. The whole team are friendly and approachable.

We have nothing negative to say about our experience with these guys. They’ve been very helpful every step of the way, and everything has run smoothly from start to finish.

We had been thinking about getting solar for a while, and once we finished the work on our roof, we decided it was the right time. The team has been really easy to work with, and everyone has been very helpful. We definitely recommend them
